review: The pool is calm and beautiful, a quiet escape from the city noise.
Service is impeccable, the staff remembered our names from the first day.
The room was lovely but the bathroom fittings felt a little dated.
Our sea facing room had a stunning view of the Gateway of India.
Extremely expensive, even a coffee at the lounge costs a fortune.
The heritage wing is breathtaking, the grand staircase and the old world decor feel like a museum.
The breakfast spread is huge and the masala dosa was excellent.
Location is perfect for walking around Colaba and the Fort area.
The wifi was slow in the room during the evenings.
Security at the entrance is thorough, which made us feel safe.
Concierge booked us a great heritage walk and a table at a busy restaurant.
Check in took almost 40 minutes because of a long queue.
Sea Lounge high tea is a must, the scones were fresh and warm.
The tower wing room was small for the price we paid.
The bed was so comfortable and the room was spotless.
Celebrated our anniversary here and the staff surprised us with a cake. Unforgettable.
